title: Process batches of vendors with Cowork
description: Onboard several vendors in one session — with Cowork, Claude can read a folder of vendor files, adds each to your tracker, generates their contracts, and fills multiple intake forms in your browser.
prompt: I need to onboard several vendors. Their documents spread across my desktop. For each new vendor: Create an NDAs and MSAs from the templates, Fill out an onboarding form, Afterwards, add all information to the vendor tracker spreadsheet. Organize all the new documents on my desktop.
steps: Describe the task and desired end state in a Cowork session
Provide Claude context by selecting a folder with vendor tracker, contract templates, and vendor details
Claude works through onboarding in stages: updating spreadsheet, completing portal forms, generating agreements
Continue conversation to refine or expand (generate additional documents, organize vendor files)
prerequisites: Claude in Chrome installed and configured
